summary.work_completed: Authored 5 regression tests (T-BUG-088-01 through T-BUG-088-05) for Issue #88 — all interactive elements non-functional. Tests are TDD-first and will FAIL against the current broken codebase, PASS after the fix.
key_findings: T-BUG-088-01: Viewport Canvas onPointerDown not wired to placement engine (RC-1 + RC-3)
T-BUG-088-02: BrickPalette onClick not connected to uiStore.setSelectedBrickType (RC-2)
T-BUG-088-03: Toolbar buttons (Undo/Redo/Clear) not wired to store actions (RC-2)
T-BUG-088-04: useKeyboardShortcuts hook not mounted in App root component (RC-4)
T-BUG-088-05: CSS pointer-events:none blocking canvas interaction (RC-6)

recommended_actions: READ docs/features/BUG/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md for the complete fix specification (RC-1 through RC-6)
RUN the regression tests first to confirm they FAIL: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/bug-088-interactive-elements.test.tsx

APPLY fixes in the order specified by the LLD: (1) CSS fix in index.css, (2) Viewport.tsx onPointerDown wiring, (3) useBrickPlacement.ts placement engine invocation, (4) BrickPalette.tsx onClick wiring, (5) Toolbar.tsx onClick wiring, (6) App.tsx useKeyboardShortcuts mount
RUN tests again after fix to confirm all 5 tests PASS
UPDATE PR #96 from draft to ready-for-review after all tests pass
acceptance_criteria: T-BUG-088-01 PASSES: Viewport Canvas fires onPointerDown and invokes useBrickPlacement
